raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) is tagged source_tz='UTC', while every other batch is America/Chicago local time, but the pipeline stores txn_ts unconverted. The UTC rows are therefore shifted about 6 hours forward, which pushes evening local transactions from 2026-01-17 into 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-18. Converting UTC-tagged timestamps to America/Chicago local time before deriving txn_date should correct the silver and gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED');"}}
